Kinda funny, the new Horla Wheel fix has made me realize my approach to writing these descriptions is completely backwards and I had no idea until now LOL

I do a lot of playtesting work to confirm what everything *actually does* so that the descriptions I submit match the actual effects in the case that they're different than what was previously written, because I'm not used to gacha games making functional changes to such old content...

But I'm aware now that everything I find to function differently (even slightly) than the given description needs to be submitted as a bug. 😅 Wish I had known sooner lol
